justification: The assessment targets the eigenspace inequality at 0687, whereas ground truth concerns failure of ad(v)-injectivity. The inequality genuinely fails, even retaining the Hodge-filtration term omitted in the assessment’s calculation. A concrete example uses C: y²=(x²+x+1)³+x²(x+1)², K=Q(i,√2), p=17, and Z={(P,sP,P,tP)}, where s,t generate C’s rational S3 action. In degree 4, dim W₄=45, dim W̄₄=15, dim F⁰D_dR(W̄₄)=1, and dim W̄₄^{c=1}=dim(W₄∩{c=1})=6. The quoted Bloch–Kato identity gives h¹_f=14−6=8. Thus the asserted inequality becomes 37≥39, which is false. This confirms a different genuine defect in the [displayed bound](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1903.05032v2#page=39).
